view.scene_description: The image shows the interior of a brightly lit store aisle with shelves stocked with personal care products. Decorative hot air balloon lanterns hang from the ceiling. A shopping cart filled with bottled beverages is near a window. Stacks of boxes and a hand truck are also visible. The overall setting suggests a retail environment with festive decorations.

objects.label: shelves with personal care products
objects.observation: Rows of shelves on the left side are densely packed with bottles and containers of shampoo, soap, and other hygiene items. The shelves extend into the background, creating depth. They are supported by metal brackets and appear to be mounted to the wall. No occlusion is evident.

objects.label: decorative hot air balloon lanterns
objects.observation: Three colorful paper lanterns shaped like hot air balloons hang from the ceiling. One is yellow and white striped, another red and white striped, and the third is solid red. They are suspended by thin wires and positioned above the aisle. They are not touching any surfaces.

objects.label: shopping cart filled with beverages
objects.observation: A metal shopping cart is located in the foreground on the right, partially obscuring a stack of beverage cases. It contains numerous plastic bottles, mostly dark-colored sodas. The cart has wheels and is positioned near a window. Its handlebar is visible.

objects.label: stacked cardboard boxes
objects.observation: Several stacks of cardboard boxes are piled up against the back wall near the window. Some boxes have green and red branding. They are stacked without apparent support structures and appear to be for storage or delivery. Their edges are visible.

objects.label: hand truck
objects.observation: A black metal hand truck stands upright near the shopping cart on the right side. Its handle is extended upward, and its base rests on the floor. It appears to be empty and ready for use. It is positioned next to the cart.

objects.label: window
objects.observation: A large window spans the back wall, allowing bright natural light to enter. The glass is transparent, and the frame is white. It is positioned behind the stacked boxes and the shopping cart. The view outside is overexposed.

prompts.native_chat_prompt_text:
<|im_start|>system
You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "thud_dense_test50/image-000034", "image_size": [960, 540], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
